sentences.en: That little fishing village by the sea is very picturesque.
sentences.zh: 那个海边的小渔村非常美丽如画。

sentences.en: Notting Hill is one of London's most picturesque neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 诺丁山是伦敦最美丽的 neighborhoods之一。

sentences.en: The villages in the Alps are very picturesque.
sentences.zh: 阿尔卑斯山区的村庄非常美丽如画。

senses.zh: （地方）古雅的，风景如画的；（语言）生动的，独特的；（服饰和外貌）引人注意的，奇特的
